# Home

The top of the Memory Vault. This page holds no facts, only where things live. Every note is reachable from here by following maps.

## Maps
- [[About this vault]] — how the vault and its agent work: the framework, conventions, and tools

## Not here
- Raw, unprocessed captures → `Inbox/`
- Retired notes, kept for reference → `Archive/`
- Agents' own working memory and Claude runtime → their folders in the workspace's `agent_brain/`
